question: What transformation of the unfolding power produces the phoneme va?
premises: It can move toward a power of a different kind.
The phoneme va is associated with pouring forth the essence of creation.
inference: When the unfolding power engages otherness, it becomes va, the phonemic expression of creative outpouring.
uncertainties: The twofold nature of unmeṣa-śakti is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Likewise, the twofold power of unfolding, moving toward a different power, becomes va, which pours forth the essence of creation.
